# Third-party components

## thai-docx

- Upstream: https://github.com/sayam/thai-docx-skill
- Version: 0.3.4
- Release: https://github.com/sayam/thai-docx-skill/releases/tag/v0.3.4
- Vendored path: `vendor/thai-docx-upstream/`
- License: MIT, Copyright (c) 2026 Sayam Sriphua
- Purpose: Thai-aware DOCX build, check, and repair runtime.

The upstream package includes `LICENSES/commonmark.js.txt`, which is retained in
`vendor/thai-docx-upstream/LICENSES/`. The upstream runtime is used as received;
project-specific orchestration lives under `scripts/`.
